name: App Icons
original_description:
Tell ChatGPT what your app does, a symbol idea, a style and your brand colors and get an app icon: one bold symbol on a rounded square, with no text.

The plugin prepares a draft with the style (flat, gradient, 3D or minimal) and the image model. When you confirm, Abracadabrax renders the icon and ChatGPT returns the link to the image.

For indie developers and small teams shipping an app.

Limitations: new icons from text only. It does not redraw an existing logo or brand, export icon size sets or vector files, or check trademarks. Producing needs a signed-in Abracadabrax account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same draft opens on Abracadabrax. Outputs are AI-generated.
